newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates-Thinly quoted for nearby position.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates-Thinly quoted for nearby position.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted for the nearby positions of June and July on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 105 percent of tariff, no comparison, offer 112-1/2 percent, no comparison.
- One barge, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 112-1/2 percent, no comparison, offer 120 percent, no comparison.
- Nine barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of June and July, bid 110 percent, no comparison, offer 120 percent.
- Nine barges, Illinois, one each week of June and July, no bid, offer 110 percent, no comparison.
